media.publicCaption: William Axt, American composer and conductor, in a portrait dated to the 1920s by the source file page.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; image dated to the 1920s; Russian Wikipedia, File:William Axt.jpg; upstream source credited there to Monstrous Movie Music.
media.rightsNote: Russian Wikipedia labels the file public domain, but its metadata does not identify the photographer or document the original publication, so that status cannot be independently confirmed. The unchanged 117 × 158 pixel source-resolution image is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator, with attribution and links to the available provenance.

contributions.scopeNote: Composer of the film’s musical score (AFI). Kaper and Jurmann contributed two songs, “There’s something in a big parade” and “Tillie, the tight rope walker”.
AFI credits Axt as music director on this film; Kaper and Jurmann wrote four of its songs with Gus Kahn. This is a supervisory music credit, not authorship of those songs.
